crossRefs.note: For Yahweh says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;
before the appointed time when the day passes as the chaff, before the fierce anger of Yahweh comes on you, before the…
Seek Yahweh, all you humble of the land, who have kept his ordinances. Seek righteousness. Seek humility. It may be…
and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.
Arise, Yahweh, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.
“Now therefore arise, Yahweh God, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength. Let your priests, Yahweh…
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, Yahweh.”

parallels.note: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

translations.web: Seek Yahweh and his strength. Seek his face forever more.
translations.bsb: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
translations.kjv: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
translations.asv: Seek ye Jehovah and his strength; Seek his face evermore.
